samples.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Reference IMAGE 1 is the gameplay/sample content to preserve. References 2 and 3 define the NEW requested illustration style. Restyle image1 into an Indian children's picture-book illustration with lightly dimensional hand-painted characters/objects, clean warm outlines and soft painted shading. MOST IMPORTANT: references2/3 have vast calm watercolor wash negative space behind a few sharp meaningful subjects. Only minimal setting marks necessary to explain the task. Remove the entire school, lake, mountains, greenery and landscape; behind title and children only soft pale blue watercolor transitioning to warm cream near table, like reference3.
